notes.title: Release 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added achievements!
[*] Made adjustments on some enemy fire rates and movement speeds in later stages.
[*] Made the targeting cursor more visible when using the mouse.
[*] Fixed the scoreboard so it displays the correct level number after a loop.
[*] Fixed a bug where dashing inside an enemy beam would rarely destroy all shields.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added tier values to items in order to distinguish them in the shop more easily.
[*] Increased the number of shields at start to 2.
[*] Added some colour to the input tutorial and it is now visible when the game is paused.
[*] Fixed the input tutorial so it updates in real time when a setting is changed.
[/list]
